# Token format

`tokens/mosaic-home.tokens.json` is generated from `src/tokens` by `npm run tokens`. Other renderers generate
their own code from it (the LVGL kit writes C++). Don't edit it by hand.

```jsonc
{
  "format": 1,                     // bumped when the shape changes; importers refuse unknown formats
  "units": { "size": "dp", "color": "#rrggbb", "alpha": "0..1" },
  "themes": [
    {
      "id": "midnight",
      "name": "Midnight",
      "description": "…",
      "dark": true,
      "highContrast": false,
      "palette": { "canvasTop": "#0c111a", "surfaceAlpha": 0.84, "series": ["#8ab4ff", …], … },
      "character": { "corners": "mosaic", "density": "regular", "depth": "shadow", "glow": 0, "outline": 1, "backdrop": true, "outlined": false },
      "home": { "heat": "#ff8a4c", "cool": "#4fc3f7", "auto": "#b39dff", "dry": "#e6c35c", "lightOn": "#ffc98a" },
      "accents": { "coral": "#ff8a70", … },
      "elevation": [{ "blur": 0, "offsetY": 0, "alpha": 0 }, …]
    }
  ],
  "scales": {
    "phone": { "type": { "display": 96, … }, "space": { "xxs": 2, … }, "radius": { "sm": 10, … }, "control": { "sm": 32, "md": 44, "lg": 52 } },
    "wearable": { … }, "tablet": { … }, "tv": { … }
  },
  "density": { "compact": 0.75, "regular": 1, "comfortable": 1.25 },
  "motion": { "fast": 140, "normal": 260, … }
}
```

## Colour roles

| Role | Use |
|---|---|
| `canvasTop`, `canvasBottom`, `glow`/`glowAlpha` | The screen background: a vertical gradient with an ambient radial glow. `canvasBottom` is also the deepest ground. |
| `surface`/`surfaceAlpha` | Cards and panels (translucent over the canvas). |
| `surfaceRaised`, `surfacePressed` | Chips, buttons and tiles on cards, and their pressed state. |
| `input` | Inset fields and wells. |
| `outline`/`outlineAlpha`, `divider` | Hairline borders; rules between rows. |
| `heading`, `text`, `textMuted`, `textFaint` | Text, strongest to faintest. |
| `accent`, `onAccent`, `accentLight`, `accentDark` | Primary actions and selection; ink on accent fills; hover/on-dark and pressed variants. |
| `focus`, `selection` | Focus rings; selected rows and text (drawn translucent). |
| `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `onStatus` | Status colours and the ink on their fills. |
| `series` | Six categorical chart colours, in order of use. |
| `scrim`/`scrimAlpha` | Behind modal overlays. |

## Resolving

Renderers resolve a theme for a device class the same way `resolveTokens` does:

- **Type, spacing:** from `scales[deviceClass]`; spacing is multiplied by `density[character.density]` and rounded.
- **Control heights:** `scales[deviceClass].control`, multiplied by `1 + (density − 1) / 2` and rounded.
- **Radii:** `corners: mosaic` takes `scales[deviceClass].radius` and pill controls. Any other corner language
  uses fixed phone radii (square 0/0/0/0, crisp 2/3/4/8, soft 5/8/10/20, round 8/12/16/28, pill 6/10/12/28 for
  sm/md/lg/xl), multiplied by 0.85 on wearables and 1.1 on tablets and TVs; only `pill` makes controls pills.
- **Elevation:** none for `depth: flat` and for high-contrast themes.

## Custom themes

A custom theme is the same `Theme` object as a built-in one, with an id of its own (lowercase letters, digits and
dashes, not a built-in id). The theme studio in the explorer makes one; the functions behind it are in
`@mosaic-home/design-system/tokens`:

- **`deriveTheme(seed)`** builds a complete theme from a built-in `base`, and optionally a `canvas`, an `ink` (body
  text) and an `accent` colour, a partial `character` and individual `palette` roles. Surfaces, dividers and the
  text steps are mixed from canvas and ink; whichever of the two is lighter decides light or dark. Text, muted
  text and ink on the accent are nudged until they reach 4.5:1 (7:1 when the base is high contrast). Status and
  chart colours come from a built-in theme of the same kind. Palette roles in the seed are applied last, as given.
- **`checkContrast(theme)`** lists the pairs every theme should meet: text on each surface and the canvas,
  headings and muted text on surfaces and ink on the accent at 4.5:1 (7:1 for high contrast), and accent and focus
  on surfaces at 3:1. Every built-in theme meets all of them.
- **`validateTheme(value)`** checks a parsed theme file and returns a clean copy, or the list of problems. Colours
  must be `#rrggbb`, so a checked theme is safe to pass to `applyTheme`.
- **`customThemeStylesheet(theme)`** writes the CSS for one theme, to load after `themes.css`:
  `[data-mh-theme='<id>']` and one block per other device class, keyed on the theme as well (a custom density or
  corner language changes the sizes the shared device blocks assume).

The studio exports three files:

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `<id>.theme.json` | The theme object. Load it with `validateTheme`, then `applyTheme(result.theme)` or `<ThemeProvider theme={…}>`. |
| `<id>.css` | `customThemeStylesheet`. Put it after `style.css` and set `data-mh-theme="<id>"`. |
| `mosaic-home.tokens.json` | This format, with the built-in themes followed by the custom one, for renderers that import tokens. |

Home colours for a custom theme are derived from its general roles (`homeColors`), and named accents follow its
light or dark setting.
